chunks: From him, from Faḍālah, from Ṣafwān, from al-ʿAlāʾ, from Muḥammad ibn Muslim, from one of the two عليهما السلام, concerning

about one who remembers that he did not say the takbir at the beginning of his salat (prayer). He said: If he becomes certain that he did not say the takbir, then let him repeat; but how can he be certain?

key_terms.يُكَبِّرْ: to pronounce the opening takbir in salat (prayer)

ai.seo_question: What should a person do if they remember missing the opening takbir in salat (prayer)?
ai.summary: This hadith addresses the ruling of one who recalls having omitted the opening takbir of salat (prayer). It states that repetition is required only if one attains certainty that the takbir was not said, while also indicating the practical difficulty of such certainty.
